title: The Ice Chimes
text: Icicles hang in the cave mouth like the pipes of an organ, long and blue, chiming in the wind. The tune they play is slow and sad and almost a voice. If you stand still and listen, it seems to be calling someone home.

options.label: Stop and listen to the chimes.

outcomes.text: A lullaby, slow and sad, and a deep rest.
A song of the frozen dead, and it wants you to lie down and join it.
Silence, sudden and total, and something in the cave wakes to it.

options.label: The wisest hums the tune back.

outcomes.text: The chimes answer, note for note, and their song shows the way.
